overview.name: Input - Placeholder Locator
overview.description:
This scenario verifies that an input element can be located using the Text locator type with the placeholder option enabled.
Test flow: 1. Navigate to UI Elements page. 2. Input a value into the Email field using the placeholder locator. 3. Verify the input value.
This scenario validates: - Text locator type with placeholder="true" - Input execution using the placeholder attribute - Verification of the entered value

assert.comment: Verify value entered using placeholder locator
